stage: digital prototype; purchased-part fit and USB enumeration not physically tested

controller.name: ESP32-S3-Zero-style FH4R2, unpopulated castellated headers
controller.note: Budget clones must match this outline and pinout. Verify the delivered PCB and USB projection; the cradle clearance is parametric.

display.name: 0.91-inch SSD1306 128x32 I2C module, direct-soldered wires
display.note: PCB dimensions are a common 0.91 module envelope, not a seller-certified tolerance. Select the 128x32 variant; 128x64 is not equivalent.

encoder.name: KY-040 / EC11 6 mm D-shaft with push switch
encoder.source: https://www.modulemore.com/product/220/ky-040-โมดูล-knob-เอ็นโค้ดเดอร์-วัดความเร็วรอบ-และสวิตซ์-rotary-encoder-module-ky-040
encoder.note: KY-040 shaft lengths vary; measure shaft_top and nut_top before printing the knob.

switch.name: Outemu MX-compatible 3-pin, conventional cruciform stem
switch.note: Do not use magnetic, low-profile or dustproof-box stem variants without checking the socket and travel coupon.

fasteners.case: 4 x M2 x 8 mm countersunk self-tapping screws
fasteners.oled: 4 x M2 x 6 mm self-tapping screws
fasteners.controller_retainer: 2 x M2 x 10 mm self-tapping screws
fasteners.note: Pilot sizing depends on print material and actual screw thread. Use the fit coupon first; no heat-set inserts are required.

print.note: Prototype dimensions and material choice require a fit print; dimensional validation is not physical certification.
